To open and save .blend files anywhere on the device (Documents, Download, SD card…), Blender needs \"All files access\".\n\nWithout it, Blender can only use its own folder (Android/data/…).
Blender is running in the background
An AI assistant can use Blender (MCP server). Tap to return to Blender.

The developer option \"Don\'t keep activities\" closes Blender each time it goes to the background (your work is auto-saved, File › Recover › Auto Save).\n\nTurn it off in Settings › Developer options to keep Blender running.
